title: HypLTSF: A Hyperbolic Geometric View of Multi-Scale Hierarchies for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.08286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-scale modeling has become an effective approach for long-term time series forecasting, capturing temporal patterns that range from fine-grained local dynamics to coarse global trends. Representations across these temporal scales are inherently hierarchical, with coarser scales abstracting and aggregating information from finer ones. While existing approaches readily exchange information across these scales, the hierarchy itself is typically left as an emergent byproduct of such interactions rather than captured as a geometric structure in its own right. In this paper, we introduce HypLTSF, a framework that endows the multi-scale hierarchy with a concrete geometric form by embedding scale-wise representations into the Poincar\'e ball, whose exponentially expanding volume naturally accommodates hierarchical structures. translated_title: HypLTSF：用于长期时间序列预测的多尺度层次结构的双曲几何视角
translated_abstract: 多尺度建模已成为长期时间序列预测的有效方法，能够捕捉从细粒度局部动态到粗粒度全局趋势的各种时间模式。这些时间尺度上的表征本质上具有层次性，较粗的尺度从较细的尺度中抽象和聚合信息。虽然现有方法可以轻松地在这些尺度之间交换信息，但层次结构本身通常只是这种交互作用的涌现副产品，而并未作为一种独立的几何结构被显式捕捉。在本文中，我们提出了HypLTSF，这是一个通过将逐尺度表征嵌入到庞加莱球中来赋予多尺度层次结构具体几何形式的框架，庞加莱球呈指数级扩张的体积天然适合容纳层次结构。为了使这种几何结构与时间层次结构对齐，HypLTSF施加了两个约束：(1) 一个径向约束……
tldr: 本文提出HypLTSF框架，通过将多尺度时间表征嵌入庞加莱球（双曲空间），首次以显式的双曲几何结构刻画长期时间序列预测中的尺度层次关系，使层次结构从交互的副产品变为被明确建模的几何对象。
en_tdlr: HypLTSF endows multi-scale hierarchies in long-term time series forecasting with an explicit hyperbolic geometric structure by embedding scale-wise representations into the Poincaré ball, rather than treating hierarchy as an emergent byproduct of cross-scale interactions.
